302| All of the above rules apply equivalently to `pyproject.toml`, `ruff.toml`, and `.ruff.toml` files.
     303| If Ruff detects multiple configuration files in the same directory, the `.ruff.toml` file will take
     304| precedence over the `ruff.toml` file, and the `ruff.toml` file will take precedence over
     305| the `pyproject.toml` file.
     306| 
     307| ### Inferring the Python version
>>   308| When no discovered configuration specifies a [`target-version`](settings.md#target-version), Ruff will attempt to fall back to the minimum version compatible with the `requires-python` field in a nearby `pyproject.toml`.
     309| The rules for this behavior are as follows:
     310| 
     311| 1. If a configuration file is passed directly, Ruff does not attempt to infer a missing `target-version`.
     312| 1. If a configuration file is found in the filesystem hierarchy, Ruff will infer a missing `target-version` from the `requires-python` field in a `pyproject.toml` file in the same directory as the found configuration.
     313| 1. If we are using a user-level configuration from `${config_dir}/ruff/pyproject.toml`, the `requires-python` field in the first `pyproject.toml` file found in an ancestor of the current working directory takes precedence over the `target-version` in the user-level configuration.
     314| 1. If no configuration files are found, Ruff will infer the `target-version` from the `requires-python` field in the first `pyproject.toml` file found in an ancestor of the current working directory.
